teams.heading: Fiji slide to three consecutive defeats following home loss against Scotland

This challenging run was compounded in July 2026 during the Nations Championship group stage, where Fiji suffered a 33-17 defeat against Scotland on home soil.

teams.heading: Eddie Hearn's million-pound demand stalls Henry Pollock's Northampton contract negotiations
teams.body: Northampton Saints are yet to reach an agreement with Henry Pollock following sports promoter Eddie Hearn’s demand earlier this month that the England flanker be handed a one-million-pound contract. Hearn’s ultimatum has stalled negotiations, with pundits recently dismissing the seven-figure sum as unrealistic for Premiership Rugby. Pollock, who impressed for England in July's victory against Argentina, is also weighing a separate offer to join the international sevens circuit. No deal has been finalised as the deadlock enters September.

The full-back has made 200 appearances for Toulouse, securing four league titles and two Champions Cups. The prospective move to Paris could see Ramos deployed at fly-half, a position he has occupied for Les Bleus but only started twice for his club last season.

Scottish rugby administrators face a protracted wait alongside fellow governing bodies, as the eventual outcome of this massive legal struggle promises to fundamentally reshape safety protocols and financial liabilities across the global game.

teams.heading: Gerónimo Prisciantelli and Joaquín Moro scores fail to mask Argentina slump
teams.body: Saturday’s 21-27 defeat in San Salvador de Jujuy highlighted a troubling trend, as the side has now managed only one win in their last five home matches. While tries from Gerónimo Prisciantelli, Joaquín Moro, and Boris Wenger kept Los Pumas within striking distance, three Australian scores inside the first 20 minutes proved decisive. Santiago Carreras added six points through conversions, yet the performance was undermined by a clinical Wallabies attack that dominated most facets of play at Estadio 23 de Agosto.

teams.heading: Timothy Lafaele and naturalised Brave Blossoms stars settle domestic eligibility dispute
teams.body: Japan Rugby League One has reached a settlement with a group of 24 foreign-born players, including Brave Blossoms stalwarts Timothy Lafaele and Jiwon Gu, over proposed eligibility restrictions. The league previously planned to limit matchday squads for the 2026-27 season based on local schooling history. Under the revised rules, naturalised citizens holding Japanese citizenship by May 2025 retain their domestic status. Crucially, any player with 30 or more Japan caps will now be reclassified to Category A-1, ensuring their professional futures remain secure.

lead.why: Significant resolution to a high-profile legal challenge involving core national team players regarding their domestic careers.

teams.heading: Rassie Erasmus labels Dave Rennie’s scrum allegations "nonsense" following Springbok series-levelling win
teams.body: South Africa reclaimed the world No. 1 ranking after Saturday’s 33-26 victory over New Zealand, though the result was overshadowed by a row over scrummaging. Rassie Erasmus bristled at claims from All Blacks coach Dave Rennie that the Boks were "walking around" the set piece, retorting, "I don’t come with that nonsense." Despite Erasmus swapping his entire starting front row an hour before kick-off, 18 points from Cheslin Kolbe and a late Cameron Hanekom turnover secured the vital win.
